items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Were you there the night that Skippy Williams was there?' but the interviewee does not respond to confirm presence or interaction, nor does he mention Skippy Williams in his own narrative turns.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's when he was on the radio.
Yeah! And we used to wait. We used to go to Val's In The Alley... Were you there the night that Skippy Williams was there?
